_comment: Strip sizes for the parallax planes (Kaya Refit phase 3). Read by tools/art/backdrops.py when it paints bg_<world>_<plane>.png, and checked by tests/test_parallax_bg.gd. The scroll factors themselves are the PARALLAX_* constants in src/world/level.gd; `factor` here mirrors them so the painter can size each strip, and the test fails if the two disagree.

_fields.design_level_h: level height in px the strip heights are sized for. Every shipped level is two screens tall (480); on that level a plane moves vertically at `vertical` x the tiles. A taller level spreads the same slack over more travel, so the plane moves slower but its edge still never shows.
_fields.factor: horizontal scroll rate as a fraction of the tiles (mirror of level.gd)
_fields.vertical: vertical scroll rate on a design-height level; sets the strip height to view_h + vertical * (design_level_h - view_h)
_fields.width: strip width in px: at least view_w + factor * (one level's horizontal travel), so a two-screen level never shows the strip repeat, and a multiple of 16 so the 4x4 dither tiles across the wrap
